dod_intent_evidence: Channel-notes/SBIR source: 'TeamWorx is developing the RCyP AI-driven cyber-triage prototype for the 16th Air Force' (sbir.gov/awards/216865); own LinkedIn about confirms 'a proven track record across the defense and intelligence communities.'
score_evidence: '3,500+ Community Partners', '5.9M+ Hours of Human Analysis Saved', '8.4M+ Conversations turned into actionable intelligence' — scale/impact metrics, not pure lab brags → lab_language_intensity kept moderate-low

'Cyber Risk Assessments: ...system categorization assessments...document controls in line with Federal, state, and NIST requirements' is essentially RMF/ATO-adjacent language offered as a service line → deployment_awareness_absence scored low, they clearly get RMF/NIST
Copy centers on 'malware experts, vulnerability researchers, hunt, cyber intelligence, and cyber defense professionals' as the community → operator_absence scored low

Multiple 'DoD SkillBridge' postings (Software Developer, Systems Administrator/Cybersecurity Specialist, Project Manager-Cyber x2, Cyber Intelligence Analyst) plus a Fort Meade-based Cyber Exercise Planner — hiring skews toward operational/military-transition roles, not pure research → hiring_profile_skew scored low

21 employees, $500K TEDCO seed (June 2025), still 'prototype' stage for RCyP per channel notes, but also just won a $20M GSA PBS BPA diversifying revenue away from the DoD prototype → stage_pressure moderate

blind_spots.blind_spot: Hive-IQ's 'collective defense' community intelligence platform is delivered as 'fully managed cloud private instances' with no stated offline/degraded mode
blind_spots.operator_reality: Forward-deployed or isolated cyber defense units (exactly the kind 16th Air Force fields) can lose reachback to a cloud-hosted hive when networks are contested; a community-intelligence tool that requires persistent cloud access goes dark for the units most likely to need shared threat data urgently
blind_spots.why_likely_missing: product is architected around a SaaS community model, not an edge/disconnected node model
blind_spots.evidence_quote: TeamWorx Security provides fully managed cloud private instances for all products available in our collective defense suite.

blind_spots.blind_spot: No public detail on an ATO/IL5 accreditation pathway or SOC/GFE integration plan for the RCyP AI-driven cyber-triage prototype built for 16th Air Force
blind_spots.operator_reality: An AI triage tool touching cyber-operations data needs an authorization to operate before an analyst can run it on a government network; without a stated accreditation timeline, a funded Phase-equivalent prototype can sit unused while the clock on its period of performance runs out
blind_spots.why_likely_missing: the 16th Air Force prototype is only referenced via SBIR/channel metadata, not detailed on the public site, suggesting the accreditation story isn't a marketed asset yet
blind_spots.evidence_quote: TeamWorx is developing the RCyP AI-driven cyber-triage prototype for the 16th Air Force.

blind_spots.blind_spot: Site markets a broad menu of consulting/staff-aug 'Expert Service offerings' (governance, curriculum, project management) more prominently than the RCyP product, and names no program-office champion for the 16th AF transition
blind_spots.operator_reality: Without a champion above the operator level actively sponsoring RCyP toward a program of record, a 21-person company pulled toward a newly won $20M GSA services BPA risks letting the DoD prototype stall — team bandwidth follows revenue, and the services book is bigger and less risky than a single Air Force prototype
blind_spots.why_likely_missing: services revenue (GSA BPA) is safer and already flowing, so the marketing site naturally foregrounds it over an unproven prototype
blind_spots.evidence_quote: TeamWorx Security offers a range of services that help organizations operationalize and mature their information and cybersecurity programs.

opener_hook: TeamWorx's RCyP cyber-triage prototype for 16th Air Force sits next to a fully cloud-hosted Hive-IQ community platform — what happens to triage when a unit can't reach the cloud?
what_they_do: A dual-use AI/software company running Hive-IQ, a cloud community threat-intelligence platform for cyber defenders, plus cybersecurity consulting services and an AI cyber-triage prototype (RCyP) for 16th Air Force.
